SR-64				STEERING — Power Steering (Gear Housing)

12. REMOVE CONTROL VALVE HOUSING
(a) Place matchmarks on the valve housing and rack housing.
(b) Remove the two bolts.
(c) Pull out the valve housing.
(d) Remove the O-ring from the rack housing.

Matchmarks
SR1541

13. REMOVE CONTROL VALVE SPRING SEAT AND SPRING

SR1567

14. REMOVE CONTROL VALVE
Remove the control valve and bearing.
HINT: Do not fall out the bearing.

SR1568

15. REMOVE CYLINDER END STOPPER, SPACER, OIL SEAL AND RACK
(a) Using snap ring pliers, remove the snap ring.

SR1543

(b) Using SST, press the rack until the end stopper slightly touches the press block.
SST 09612-24014 (09612-10061)
(c) Pull out the rack with the cylinder end stopper, spacer and oil seal.
HINT: If necessary, slightly tap the rack end with a brass bar and hammer.

SST

SR1320 SR1734
